snippet.title: The Final Exhibit - Official Game Teaser
snippet.description:
Discover The Final Exhibit, a psychological horror game set in a mysterious museum. Restore corrupted works of art and uncover the truth behind the presence lurking within.
The demo will be available on October 19 for Steam Next Fest.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5367370/The_Final_Exhibit_Demo/
Add the game to your wishlist, and we'll see you in the museum... 👀
#indiedev #gamedev #psychologicalhorror
